newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UIC buys 20 pct stake in engineering firm.
newsitem.headline: UIC buys 20 pct stake in engineering firm.

text.p: Property and trading-based United Industrial Corp Ltd (UIC) said on Monday it had entered into an agreement to buy a 20 percent stake in Yongnam Holdings (Pte) Ltd (YNH) for Singapore $11 million.
UIC said in a statement the deal was carried through its subsidiary Alshine Pte Ltd.

It said the purchase price was adjustable to take into account a price earnings ratio of 7.97 times the proforma audited net profit of YNH for the year ended December 31, 1996, currently estimated at S$6.9 million.
The earnings would include YNH's subsidiaries and a related firm Yongnam Engineering & Constuction Pte Ltd to be injected into YNH.
The YNH group is involved in structural engineering, specialist civl engineering and mechanical engineering in Asia Pacific.
On completion of the deal, YNH would become an associated company of UIC, the statement said.
